conventions.confirmed: true only when the figure was read on the publisher's own page, PDF, data file or API (or a verbatim copy cited); false when it came only from a search summary or a third-party page.
conventions.noOwnEstimates: No figure here is computed by the researcher. Where a share or per-item figure would need division of two published numbers, both published numbers are given and the division is left to the consumer.
conventions.chartReads: Where a value was read from a chart's data labels in a PDF (INEGI ENUT 2024), that is said in the note.
